# META-INSIGHTS — about the optimization PROCESS itself (this run)

Not about the capability — about HOW this run is searching for it: which strategies/edit classes/algorithms are helping vs stalling, and what to try next iteration. Update at the end of the run at minimum; sooner if a plateau or a clear strategy shift is worth recording now. Structure each addition as:

    ## Iteration <id> (or 'run so far')
    - Strategy tried, and whether it moved val (cite LEDGER rows):
    - Plateau/stall signal, if any, and the lever switched to:
    - What to try next iteration:

<!-- cap-evolve:meta-insights-append-below -->

## Iteration cand_0001 (run so far)
- Strategy tried: single-candidate breadth pass from seed. Diagnosed only 2 controllable failures (8/10 tasks are infra timeouts), which share one dominant root cause (misreading the NL request). Shipped 5 additive rules + 1 structural checklist across prompt.md + task_template.md. LEDGER has no result yet.
- Key process win: this seed is nearly bare (no perform-vs-code rule, no type rule, no inspect/checklist). The highest-leverage move was re-installing VERIFIED gold-checked rules from prior-run memory rather than inventing edits — memory carried which levers regressed (formulas) so I avoided re-testing them.
- Plateau/stall: n/a (first iteration). Risk: 8/10 val tasks are infra noise, so val signal is dominated by 2 tasks — a single accept hinges on 160-6 (tractable) since 53161 is all-or-nothing hard.
- What to try next: if the run's infra stabilizes and more tasks execute, re-diagnose the newly-runnable tasks. For 53161, if still failing, switch lever from rules to a WORKED cross-tab example (schedule × category) — emphasis alone won't move an all-or-nothing hard task.
